# Install `motion-primitives` — Motion Primitives (8)

> Eight ready-to-style motion components: marquee, kinetic-heading, magnetic, cursor-spotlight, stat-counter, reading-progress, grain, lightbox.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add motion-primitives
# alias: npx rr add motion-primitives
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `motion`, `animation`, `marquee`, `framer-motion`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add motion-primitives`. Each primitive is independently importable from @/features/motion-primitives. Use marquee for logo strips, kinetic-heading for hero text, magnetic for CTA buttons, cursor-spotlight for hover-reveal panels, stat-counter for animated numbers, reading-progress for blog top bar, grain for film texture, lightbox for image gallery.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
